connections.why: The induction ring is where Faraday's lines of force first did work; this frame follows the idea behind them, from action at a distance to a field that holds energy.
That frame tells how Maxwell's field equations gave the speed of light; this one follows his claim in the same 1865 paper that the field's energy is real and lives in the space around bodies.
Wheeler and Feynman tried to write electrodynamics with no field at all, charges acting directly on one another: the test the field idea survived.

Aristotle held that a mover must touch what it moves and that there is no void; Newton's gravity broke both rules, and Newton himself called acting through a vacuum absurd, until the field filled the space again.
